label: Coastal population
descriptor: Coastal population, million (2.5 in 1999), growing 3.7% per year (3.1.1).

label: Poverty
descriptor: Share of the population below the poverty line (42%, 3.1.4).

label: Unemployment
descriptor: Unemployment rate (40% in 2001, 3.1.2).

label: Tourism employment
descriptor: Jobs in coastal tourism; when tourism fell (1997-98) boat operators turned to fishing (3.1.5).

label: Traditional fishing customs
descriptor: Customary rules (taboos, elders) that regulate where and how to fish; their decay leads young fishers to non-traditional gears (3.1.3).

label: Sea warming
descriptor: Rising sea surface temperature (external variability; +1.5 C in the 1998 event, 3.3.4).

label: General fishing effort
descriptor: Number of fishers per km2 and the catch they take (3.2.1-3.2.2); the trend in total catch is the alternative indicator.

label: Triggerfish fishing
descriptor: Fishing of the urchin's predators, e.g. the red-lined triggerfish Balistapus undulatus (3.3.3).

label: Destructive gear use
descriptor: Frequency of use of beach seines and spear guns (3.2.3).

label: Thermal stress (bleaching)
descriptor: Coral bleaching episodes driven by warm-water anomalies (3.3.4).

label: Fish abundance
descriptor: Fish biomass, kg/ha (3.3.1).

label: Live coral cover
descriptor: Percentage of live hard coral and reef complexity; fished reefs have half the cover of unfished ones (3.3.2).

label: Sea urchin density
descriptor: Density of grazing and rock-boring urchins (no./m2), released when their predators are fished; they erode the reef and compete with fish (3.3.3).

label: Declining catch per fisher
descriptor: Catch per unit effort, kg per fisher (3-4 kg/day, 3.4.1).

label: Livelihood benefits compromised
descriptor: Share of household income and food that depends on the reef (3.4.2).

label: Exclusion and conflicts
descriptor: Fishers excluded and number of conflicts among reef users (3.4.3).

label: No-take marine parks
descriptor: Existing in 2007: four marine parks with no extraction (3.5.1). Also excludes fishers.

label: Gear restrictions
descriptor: Existing in 2007: Fisheries Act gear and mesh rules, reserves with gear restrictions; beach seines banned but still used (3.5.1).

label: Education and awareness
descriptor: Existing in 2007: awareness campaigns and meetings with fishers (3.5.2).

label: Tourism-based alternative livelihoods
descriptor: Recommended (section 6): develop tourism and other income around parks to remove fishers from the reef.

label: Co-management with access rights
descriptor: Recommended (section 6): licences, exclusive access rights and collaborative (ICZM) management with local fishers.

label: Gear exchange with credit
descriptor: Recommended (section 6): credit to buy authorized gear and compensation for gear declared illegal.
